title: Onboarding a new employer

steps.title: Enter the company details and create the employer
Check the agreement signer against the signatory list
Set the contribution rates and effective date
Save the rates and activate the employer

decisions: If the person who signed the participation agreement is on the authorised signatory list, mark the documents verified; if not, stop and send the agreement back for a proper signature.
If the employer asks for an employer rate below the statutory minimum of 5%, reject it; at 5% or above, use the rate they signed for.
warnings: Never send the welcome pack before the rates are saved: the schedule template in the pack is built from the rates and would go out blank.
openQuestions: Whether a mid-month starter pays a full or part first month: Halima will confirm the first-contribution rule with Compliance.
